generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular contractor/ authorized agency/firm who have carried out at least one work related to gasket replacement/overhauling/repair of Transformer of 60MVA or above rated capacity in Govt. organizations/Public Sector Undertakings/Reputed organizations in the preceding 5 financial years in India. In proof, bidder shall furnish work order copy of a single work carried out by the bidder of value not less than Rs.12.20 Lakhs and satisfactory perfor-mance/Work done certificate issued from the competent authority. Work done of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year (i.e., For the period 2021-22(50%), 2022-23(40%), 2023-24(30%), 2024-25(20%), and 2025-26(10%)).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of a single work order & its work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have achieved a minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs. 24.40 Lakhs in any two financial years in the preceding five completed financial year. In proof, Annual Report / Turn-Over Certificates/profit and loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant shall be furnished. Financial turnover of previous year will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year (i.e., 2021-22(50%), 2022-23(40%), 2023-24(30%), 2024-25(20%), and 2025-26(10%)).
